idea-plugin.name: CryptoWatch
idea-plugin.description:
CryptoWatch brings real-time cryptocurrency market data right into your IDE, so you can follow the market without switching to a browser while coding.

Key Features
  • Millisecond real-time WebSocket prices: prices come from the Binance WebSocket service (data-stream.binance.vision) via the trade stream (@trade), so every executed trade pushes an update and prices keep ticking — no polling, no manual refresh. A 24h mini-ticker stream is merged on top to provide change percentage and turnover. This domain stays reachable even on restricted networks; dropped connections reconnect automatically with exponential backoff, and idle connections are rebuilt.
  • Watchlist plus top-coin subscriptions: coins in your watchlist are always subscribed to real-time prices, and the remaining slots follow the top coins by market cap (40 by default, configurable in settings), so major pairs are live out of the box.
  • Full coin list: the coin list and market caps come from the CoinLore aggregate API (api.coinlore.net, an ordinary public site that usually needs no proxy). It is fetched at a low frequency and merged with live prices, so you can search the whole market while still seeing real-time quotes.
  • Readable failures: when a data source is unavailable, the concrete reason is shown above the list together with a hint to check your network or proxy, instead of leaving a blank panel.
  • Watchlist-only view: the list shows only your watchlist by default and always (BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB are preloaded). Double-click any row to add or remove it, and use the search box to locate coins quickly inside the watchlist.
  • Compact info panel: select a coin to see its latest price, 24h change, turnover and market cap.
  • Reuses the IDE proxy: the IDE's own HTTP proxy settings are used directly and are respected by WebSocket long connections too, so nothing has to be configured twice; a dedicated proxy can also be set in the plugin settings.
  • Persistent watchlist: type any coin symbol manually to add it, and the data is persisted to disk.
  • Follows the IDE theme: text uses the IDE foreground color and stays legible in both light and dark themes.
Usage: open the CryptoWatch tool window in the right sidebar; prices refresh automatically in real time. Use "Add to Watchlist" to enter a new coin and double-click a row to remove it from the watchlist. Subscription scope, data sources and proxy are configured under Settings > Tools > CryptoWatch.

Compatibility: IntelliJ Platform 2020.3 and later (IDEA / PyCharm / WebStorm, etc.).
CryptoWatch 简介：在 IDE 里直接看加密货币行情，写代码不用切浏览器。

核心特性
  • WebSocket 毫秒级实时价：价格来自币安 WebSocket （data-stream.binance.vision）的逐笔成交流（@trade）， 每当市场上有成交就立即推送，因此价格会持续跳动；不做轮询、无需手动刷新。 同时叠加 24h 精简行情流提供涨跌幅与成交额。该域名在受限网络下仍可连通； 断线会自动重连（指数退避），连接长时间收不到推送也会自动重建。
  • 自选 + 热门币订阅：自选列表里的币种始终订阅实时价，其余按市值排名订阅前 N 个 （默认 40，可在设置中调整），因此开箱即可看到主流币的实时报价。
  • 完整币种列表：币种列表与市值来自 CoinLore 聚合接口 （api.coinlore.net，普通公网站点，通常无需代理即可访问）， 低频拉取后与实时价合并，因此既能搜索全市场，又能看到实时价格。
  • 失败可读：数据源不可用时，列表上方会直接显示具体原因， 并提示检查网络或代理，不再只留一片空白。
  • 只看自选：列表默认且始终只展示自选币种（默认内置 BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB）， 双击任意行即可加入/移出自选，搜索框可在自选范围内快速定位。
  • 精简信息小框：选中币种即可看到最新价、24h 涨跌、成交额与市值。
  • 复用 IDE 代理：直接使用 IDE 自身的 HTTP 代理设置，WebSocket 长连接同样遵循， 无需重复配置；也支持在插件设置里单独指定代理。
  • 自选列表：支持手动输入任意币种加入自选，数据落盘持久化。
  • 跟随 IDE 主题：文字统一使用 IDE 前景色，亮色/暗色主题下均清晰可读。
使用：右侧边栏打开 CryptoWatch 工具窗口，价格会自动实时刷新； 「加入自选」用于输入新币种，双击列表行可移出自选； 订阅范围、数据源与代理在 设置 > 工具 > CryptoWatch 中调整。

兼容性：兼容 IntelliJ Platform 2020.3 及以上版本（含 IDEA / PyCharm / WebStorm 等）。
